MU.pe_narrative: MU re-rated from ~8-10x forward EPS in 2024-25, when memory was priced as a cyclical, capex-heavy commodity prone to glut, to a still-modest ~6-12x forward multiple today despite the 2026 AI/HBM surge. New Street's Aug-26 upgrade called memory 'no longer cyclical' and Deutsche Bank's $1,500 target cited DRAM tightness into 2028+, but the Street still discounts boom-bust reversal risk over a full structural re-rate.

3690.pe_narrative: Meituan's multiple collapsed through 2025-early 2026 as the Alibaba/JD instant-retail subsidy war erased its two-year profit run — S&P cut EBITDA assumptions to 20-30% of 2024 peak and stripped its A- rating, citing structural share loss (on-demand share fell ~70%→~50%). The multiple has since re-rated up from trough as SAMR's March 2026 'end the price war' intervention, sequential loss-narrowing (Q1→Q2), and JPMorgan's Aug-2026 upgrade confirmed durable food-delivery profitability.
